newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian Die Erste, GiroCredit sign merger deal.
newsitem.headline: Austrian Die Erste, GiroCredit sign merger deal.

text.p: Austrian savings bank Die Erste said on Friday it had signed the proposed merger agreement with GiroCredit.
Together, the two savings banks form the country's second biggest banking group with combined assets of almost 670 billion schillings ($55.2 billion) and a total of 360 branches across Austria.

Die Erste, also known as First Austrian, acquired a majority stake in GiroCredit for 8.24 billion schillings in March. The acquisition of the stake from Vienna City holding AVZ raised Die Erste's stake in GiroCredit to 82 percent of ordinary voting shares.

The Vienna bourse earlier today suspended trading in the shares of both banks until July 4, when Die Erste's supervisory bodies will decide further measures concerning the preferred shares, Die Erste said. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 53112257 ($ = 12.13 Austrian Schillings)
